question: As per the census of 2011, the most populous state of India was:
solution:
The correct answer is **Uttar Pradesh**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** According to Census 2011 Uttar Pradesh is the most Populous State in India.

__
 
• The total population of Uttar Pradesh is **19.98 Crores**
 
• Other most Populous States in India After Uttar Pradesh are **Maharastra, Bihar and West Bengal.**
 
• Rajasthan is the largest state in India** by Area.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The 15th Census** of India was Started on 1st April 2011.
 
• It was conducted by the **Ministry of Home Affairs** under **the Registrar General of India and ex-officio Census Commissioner.**
 
• 1st Census was conducted under British viceroy **Lord Mayo in 1872** non-synchronously.
 
• **1st Decadal census Started in 1881.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
